comparison.objective: Select a friction liner that stabilizes a glass on an incline versus mechanically tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Material selection and released placement of liner/glass versus tool alignment, collar adjustment, counterhold, torque control, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Glass remains stable for specified 10/20-second intervals versus two repeatable impact stops and witness-tested lock retention.
comparison.reason: The underlying tested abilities—friction/material choice versus adjustable energy absorption—are meaningfully different.
